title: Global Natural and Planted Forests (30m)
description: 30 m global map distinguishing natural forest, planted forest, and non-forest, from Xiao Yuelong (2024), "Global Natural and Planted Forests Mapping at Fine Spatial Resolution of 30m." Forest class is encoded as RGB colour: green = natural forest, yellow = planted forest, other = non-forest. This is an unmodified mirror of the Zenodo release (record 10701417, CC-BY 4.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10701417), republished as cloud-optimized GeoTIFF tiles with a geoparquet STAC index and a virtualizarr/icechunk store for cloud-native access. Cite Xiao Yuelong (2024); modifications (if any) are flagged in the repository README.
